newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold suffers on low wedding season demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold suffers on low wedding season demand.

text.p: Indian gold prices fell in early trade on Tuesday on lower than expected demand for the wedding season and fresh arrivals, dealers said.
Gold was down by 15 rupees per 10 grammes on Monday.
Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 grammes) fell by 100 rupees to 58,700 rupees. It fell by 100 rupees per piece on Monday.
Biscuit prices fell by 550 rupees per piece last week.

Silver prices held steady at the reduced level. Silver fell by 10 rupees per kg on Monday. "Prices in the world market are stabilising and local traders expect fresh physical support for the wedding season," he said.
